policy: Full unpruned model resident in GPU or unified memory, including lookup tables. Weights are shared across concurrent sessions. Exclude expert/lookup disk streaming and sub-4-bit compression. Memory and cost are planning estimates, not verified throughput or vendor quotes. Explicit user-approved model_overrides may use other quantization or disk-backed tables; their source notes describe the exception.

proposed_fallback.parameter_definition: Total resident parameters, including all experts and lookup/Engram/N-gram tables; do not use activated parameters.
proposed_fallback.resident_memory_rule_decimal_gb: 0.625 * total_params_b + 16 (4-bit weights +25%reserve +16GBfixed allowance); illustrative, not architecture-specific context validation.
proposed_fallback.precedence: Qualifying measured deployment or detailed resident memory/configuration evidence overrides this fallback; unknown counts remain unknown.
proposed_fallback.notes: The small-server band also permits a larger desktop cluster with sufficient resident memory. Four Sparks do not meet the saved DeepSeek V4.1 Flash estimate. All fallback assignments are estimates.
proposed_fallback.approval_context: User accepted roughly indicative estimates using Kimi K3 and requested reasonable parallelism from larger desktop clusters onwards.

label_policy: User requested cost-band labels by their upper bound; the final tier remains open-ended.
presentation: Cost of AI title citations removed; sources retained without display. Hosting slide has one frame and no popup.
palette_policy: Warm desktop tiers through magenta at ≤S$25k; blue at ≤S$100k; progressively darker blues at ≤S$500k and >S$500k. Colors are defined in make_chart.py HARDWARE_COLORS.
other_group_policy: API-only and hosting-unknown data statuses retain their source meanings but merge visually into one grey Other category.

approved_model_overrides.deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash: User explicitly requested ≤S$25k after reviewing two-Spark local hosting recipes. See hosting_tiers.json model_overrides.
